text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's about time Machan showed a brand 
new side of herself to the world.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fierce clashes with rivals! ...Exciting, 
but already done quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A new side... a new side...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Something flashy. Explosive. With a bit of 
surprise! Like...—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aww man, isn't there anything fun to do~! 
Teio won't race me, and Nature says she's 
tired...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I happen to have something fun, you know?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so! The Turbo-Machan duo is officially 
born right here!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! We're a duo now~~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...So, what're we gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, we figure that out from here. First, 
let's properly introduce ourselves once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am Aston Machan. My dream is to become 
the world's number one mascot character. 
As a token of our new friendship, please 
take this.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! It's that plushie you hand out 
sometimes! Turbo loves plushies too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! In this video Turbo made— this 
rabbit plushie! His name is Triple Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oho, how adorable! A plushie named Triple 
Turbo-san, and you even make videos... I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait? Ah, I've got it. A combination of 
our duo's cute special talents...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Namely! Shooting videos with our friendly 
plushie duo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How about the concept of: "Cute fluffy 
plushies going on a stroll"...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A stroll!? Whoa, Triple Turbo gets to go 
on a walk? Then, then... Turbo wants to 
pick where we go!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! The flowers are so pretty! I 
wanna roll around right here--!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how daring...! Though that would 
definitely look cute. Shall we have the 
plushies do it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Warm and sunny skies. The plushie duo fast 
asleep.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... Machan, you're super good at 
framing cute shots!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, there are so many places I wanna 
go! Turbo will take you to all of them! 
I'll leave the cuteness to you!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My, my, quite the bundle of energy. Leave 
it to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, good edit. Every single shot 
turned out exceedingly pretty.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Okay, time for voiceover! Here we 
go, here we go--!!

text_block_list.name: Triple Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! Awesome--! Flowers! Flowers! 
Floweeers----!!"

text_block_list.name: Machan Doll
text_block_list.text:
"Yes indeed! Triple Turbo-san, the breeze 
smells wonderful all the way!"

text_block_list.name: Machan Doll
text_block_list.text: "Alright, hide-and-seek, start! Wheee!"

text_block_list.name: Triple Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Yaaay! Triple Turbo, full throttle 
ahead--!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...They look like they're having fun. The 
doll duo, that is.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It looks totally different from when he 
plays with Turbo in my room.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Same for the Machan doll.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san, shall we film the sequel right 
away? Now that they've become such good 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah, yeah!! Let's play again real 
soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While watching the cute doll stroll video 
on campus... the two creators themselves 
walked up right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. "Cute," "So soothing," "Great 
combo"... Rave reviews all around.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, told ya so, told ya so! I worked 
super hard on the editing!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a nice edit. Now then, let's 
hold a meeting for the next project right 
away—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*Bleep*, our eyes met. Trainer-san over 
there. What do you think would be good?
choice_data_list: A video ambushing your rival duos

How about a video showing the editing 
behind-the-scenes!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Part 2 is in high demand... 
We must be careful not to flop on the 
sequel~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Though as long as the plushies have 
fun, there's no such thing as flopping, is 
there?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aaalright! A declaration of war, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And off she goes. Hmmm, wait up, 
please~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, a behind-the-scenes 
making-of video. There might actually be 
demand for that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I actually had some questions for Master 
Turbo anyway... hmm. Please look forward 
to the behind-the-scenes of our duo.
